keyFindings.text: **CONFIRMED — a permission prompt is not PreToolUse-visible as a prompt.** PreToolUse runs for every tool call whether or not it needs permission, while PermissionRequest runs only when Claude is about to ask for permission, and PreToolUse cannot refuse the prompt without refusing the tool call itself [SOURCE: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/hooks]. PermissionRequest can deny through its own decision object, but exit code 2 is not honored there [SOURCE: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/hooks]. The Claude `eventOrder` has no `PermissionRequest`, so no such binding can render today [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:9]. Only Devin has a PermissionRequest binding in the registry [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:917].

**CONFIRMED — an unreadable record fails open in the guard and silently kills the hop in Stop.** `readRelaunchFile` catches a JSON syntax error, logs `corrupt-relaunch-file`, and returns null [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:1265]. The guard turns that null (and any thrown read) into `no-record`, so the dialog is allowed [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/subagent-guard.mjs:74]. Stop reads null and returns without arming [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/stop-arm.mjs:101]. The dialog works and the prepared hop is dead; the only trace is the log line. The core read is tested [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/tests/relaunch-core.test.cjs:1011], but no guard or Stop test asserts the paired behavior, so limitation 3's "no test" is still true for this path [SOURCE: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions/session-turn-boundaries/002-session-relaunch-loop/039-hop-dialog-goal-title/001-sender-dialog-after-prepare/implementation-summary.md:129].

**CONFIRMED — limitation 5 is real, and the guard holds on any readable pending record.** `pendingHandOver` denies the dialog exactly when `armableRecord` reports `reason === 'pending'` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/subagent-guard.mjs:65] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/subagent-guard.mjs:82] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/subagent-guard.mjs:117]. `armableRecord` returns `pending` for any matching record whose `status` is `pending`, before it looks at anything else [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:1133]. The recorded limitation matches the code [SOURCE: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions/session-turn-boundaries/002-session-relaunch-loop/039-hop-dialog-goal-title/001-sender-dialog-after-prepare/implementation-summary.md:131].

**CONFIRMED — limitation 6 for plan approval.** Claude's PreToolUse matches every built-in tool except `EndConversation`, and `ExitPlanMode` is explicitly one of them; `AskUserQuestion` and `ExitPlanMode` both require user interaction [SOURCE: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/hooks]. The registry binds the guard to `AskUserQuestion` only [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:1184], and the sync script only renders events named in the runtime's `eventOrder` [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/sync-hook-registrations.cjs:125]. An `ExitPlanMode` approval after `prepare` therefore holds the turn open with no refusal; that it can park the hop is inference from the same turn-holding mechanism, not a live observation [INFERENCE: based on the guard matcher and the documented interaction requirement].

**CONFIRMED — only the deferred state has an escape besides `cancel`.** The Claude UserPromptSubmit nudge calls `withdrawHandOver` without a pending policy [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/context-nudge.mjs:63], so the default `pending: 'deferred'` applies and only a pending record carrying `deferredAt` counts [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/withdraw.cjs:26]. `markDeferred` writes that stamp only inside the background-task branch [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/stop-arm.mjs:143]. Therefore a prompt clears a background-task deferral, but a record parked by a missing transcript path, a missing target pid, or an arm failure has no `deferredAt` and is cleared only by `cancel`, whose policy is `pending: 'any'` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/bin/session-relaunch.cjs:877], or by a later Stop that succeeds. The limitation's own example ("because the Stop was deferred") is the one parked state that already has a way out [SOURCE: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions/session-turn-boundaries/002-session-relaunch-loop/039-hop-dialog-goal-title/001-sender-dialog-after-prepare/implementation-summary.md:131].

**CONFIRMED — Pi, OpenCode and Codex all have a question tool, and none is guarded.** The shared ask-surface table records Codex `request_user_input`, OpenCode `question`, and Pi `ask_user_question`/`question` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/ask-surface-guard/lib/ask-surface-core.cjs:24]. Pi's tool comes from the installed `@juicesharp/rpiv-ask-user-question` package [SOURCE: .pi/PLUGINS.md:16], and Pi's context gates whether a session may ask at all on `hasUI` [SOURCE: .pi/types/pi-coding-agent.d.ts:34]. The arm events are Stop for Codex [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/codex/stop-arm.mjs:89], `session.idle` for OpenCode [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/opencode/session-relaunch.js:496], and `agent_settled` for Pi [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/pi/session-relaunch.ts:606]; a question that blocks the turn keeps those events from firing, so the exposure class is the same. Today nothing in the relaunch path guards the tool: the Codex bindings are UserPromptSubmit, PostToolUse and Stop only [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:1191], Pi registers only message_end, before_agent_start, agent_end, agent_settled, agent_start and session_compact [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/pi/session-relaunch.ts:505], and the OpenCode plugin handles only session.idle, message.updated, message.part.updated, session.compacted and session.deleted [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/opencode/session-relaunch.js:404]. The ask-surface guard is a different concern: it sends prose menus back through the question tool and cannot block Pi's end-of-run events [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/ask-surface-guard/pi/ask-surface-guard.ts:4].

**CONFIRMED — smallest fix for item 2, in two sizes.** The one-line increment is to accept `ExitPlanMode` in `pendingHandOver` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/subagent-guard.mjs:25] and change the matcher to `AskUserQuestion|ExitPlanMode` (the exact-string matcher supports `|`) [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:1184]. Covering permission prompts needs a second increment: add `PermissionRequest` to the Claude `eventOrder`, bind the guard, and branch its output to the PermissionRequest decision shape, because the envelope differs per event [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:9]. Elicitation is a third binding. The denial wording for plan approval must say to end the turn and put the plan in the note, not to re-plan.

**CONFIRMED — smallest fix for item 3.** Validate the record shape once in `readRelaunchFile` (non-empty `handoff`, `loopId`, `sessionId`, known `status`) and treat a shape failure like corrupt JSON: log `corrupt-relaunch-file` and return null. That makes the guard fail open with a log line instead of denying on `undefined`, and makes Stop refuse rather than arm a note-less hop. A guard test writes `{invalid` and a shape-invalid pending object to `relaunchFilePath(LOOP_ID, sandbox.env)` and asserts a silent allow; a Stop test asserts no arm and the log line. Both belong beside the existing question cases in `subagent-guard.test.cjs` and the Stop cases in `claude-adapters.test.cjs`.

**CONFIRMED — the remaining hold-open surfaces are separate events.** MCP elicitation is visible only through `Elicitation`, which can decline on exit 2 or through its action field, not through PreToolUse [SOURCE: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/hooks]. `Notification` exposes `permission_prompt` and `agent_needs_input` types but is observational and cannot end a turn [SOURCE: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/hooks]. `EndConversation` skips PreToolUse but ends the conversation rather than holding it open, so it is not a hop-park [SOURCE: https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/hooks]. None of these is bound to the guard [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:1180].

**CONFIRMED — the smallest fix for item 1.** In `armPendingRecord`, call `markDeferred({ loopId, env })` on each post-read path that leaves the record pending (missing transcript, no target pid, arm failure), so the existing prompt-withdraw policy clears every parked state. Widening the nudge to `pending: 'any'` would also withdraw a record prepared moments earlier in the same turn, which `withdraw.cjs` deliberately excludes [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/withdraw.cjs:21]. The denial reason should also say a prompt clears a parked hop, matching the background-task notice [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/stop-arm.mjs:151].

**CONFIRMED — the states where Stop leaves a readable record pending.** After a successful read, `armPendingRecord` returns without arming and without changing `status` when `transcript_path` is missing [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/stop-arm.mjs:124], when no killer target pid resolves [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/stop-arm.mjs:169], and when `arm` throws or returns a non-armed record [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/stop-arm.mjs:196]. A read error is a fourth path but leaves the guard fail-open, so it does not produce the refusal [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/stop-arm.mjs:101].

**CONFIRMED — their user-message withdrawal takes only an armed record.** Codex, OpenCode and Pi all call `withdrawHandOver` with `pending: 'none'` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/codex/shared.mjs:67] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/opencode/session-relaunch.js:290] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/pi/session-relaunch.ts:643], so answering the question does not clear a still-pending record. Answering lets the run end, and the arm event then fires. The failure window is an unanswered question at the context limit, the same window the Claude guard closes.

**CONFIRMED by reading — a parseable but structurally malformed record is treated as pending.** `armableRecord` checks only `loopId`, `sessionId`, `runtime` and `status` before returning `pending` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:1125]. A record with those fields and no `handoff` is denied with `undefined` interpolated into the note path [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/claude/subagent-guard.mjs:89], and `armLocked` spreads it into an armed record without validating `handoff` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:1046]. This is worse than invalid JSON: the hop can arm with no note. No test feeds a shape-invalid record to the guard or Stop.

**Smallest fix per runtime for item 4 (recommendation).** Codex already has a PreToolUse event in its `eventOrder` [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:24], so a `request_user_input` matcher can reuse the same pending check with no new event support. OpenCode needs a `tool.execute.before` hook in the plugin module, which today registers no tool hook [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/opencode/session-relaunch.js:404]. Pi needs a `tool_call` handler in the extension; the registry records that Pi's `tool_call` event already carries a decision [SOURCE: .skilled/skills/system-spec-kit/runtime/cli/runtime-mirrors/hook-registry.json:930]. The exact blocking semantics of each runtime's question tool were not observed live this iteration, per the no-runtime constraint.

**CONFIRMED — a goal cleared by hand comes back through the no-goal-entry fallback.** `prepare` validates the note and calls `recordGoalPacket`, which resolves the sender's goal before writing the note [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/bin/session-relaunch.cjs:482] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/bin/session-relaunch.cjs:391]. For Claude, `resolveGoalPacketResult` routes to `claudeGoalPacketResult` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:896]. In the clearing session the newest goal entry is the `/goal clear` system line [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:560], it is not active [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:563], and the resolver returns no packet [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:660]. `recordGoalPacket` then removes `goal_packet` from the note [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:952]; the CLI test asserts that drop [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/tests/session-relaunch-cli.test.cjs:2625]. In the next session the log holds no goal entry, so `latest` is null while `whole` is true [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:653], and the fallback picks the first ancestor whose goal.md has budget `ok` and an unticked `- [ ]` line [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:601] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:656]. That packet is written to the new note [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/bin/session-relaunch.cjs:404], consumed [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/bin/session-relaunch.cjs:802], and turned into the `/goal <slice>` start prompt [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/skilled-loop:1344]. **How it fails:** the clear suppresses exactly one hop; the hop after that has no goal entry to suppress the fallback, and the packet goal with unticked criteria is carried again. The recorded limitation already names this timing [SOURCE: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions/session-turn-boundaries/002-session-relaunch-loop/039-hop-dialog-goal-title/002-packet-goal-fallback/implementation-summary.md:127]. **Smallest change:** see finding 8.

**CONFIRMED — both bugs are Claude-only, as recorded.** `resolveGoalPacketResult` sends Claude to `claudeGoalPacketResult` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:896], the record runtimes to `recordedGoalPacket`/`handoverGoalPacket` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:891], and Codex to a reason with no packet [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:899]. Child 002's "Claude only" limitation is accurate [SOURCE: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions/session-turn-boundaries/002-session-relaunch-loop/039-hop-dialog-goal-title/002-packet-goal-fallback/implementation-summary.md:130].

**CONFIRMED — carrying the ending closes item (1), not item (2).** An ending latch suppresses the fallback for the packet whose goal ended. A stale parent is a different packet whose goal may never have ended; the latch does nothing about it. The 002 decision table already says the ending idea "would close the cleared-goal gap" and stops there [SOURCE: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions/session-turn-boundaries/002-session-relaunch-loop/039-hop-dialog-goal-title/002-packet-goal-fallback/implementation-summary.md:99]. Item (2) still needs finding 6.

**CONFIRMED — smallest change for the title: strip only a name the wrapper can prove it numbered.** `name_stem` has no source information today. The wrapper's own launch stem is in `SKILLED_LOOP_NAME`, so the strip can require a non-empty stem and an exact match of `"$SKILLED_LOOP_NAME ($sender_number)"` before removing the suffix [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/skilled-loop:286]. In the 003 case the session was never named, so the stem is empty and a generated title such as `Fix bug (2)` would survive; a launched or renamed session keeps the intended strip. This is a wrapper change, not a record key, so D3 is unaffected. A wrapper test with an empty stem and a record name ending in the sender's number proves it.

**CONFIRMED — the added search is one more tail read per Claude prepare, and its worst case is the whole file.** `readClaudeSettings` runs three tail searches: the last assistant turn [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/context-usage.cjs:239], the last `custom-title` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/context-usage.cjs:244] and the last `ai-title` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/context-usage.cjs:250]. `resolveSessionSettings` is called only by `prepare` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/bin/session-relaunch.cjs:584] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:766]. Each search starts at 262,144 bytes [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/context-usage.cjs:18] and widens x4 up to 16 MiB [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/context-usage.cjs:21] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/context-usage.cjs:116], re-reading from the end each pass. **ESTIMATE (constant-derived, not measured):** a hit inside the last 256 KiB costs 0.25 MiB in one pass; a miss (no `ai-title`) on a ≥16 MiB log costs 0.25 + 1 + 4 + 16 = 21.25 MiB in four passes, with every line parsed each pass. The 003 addition is the `ai-title` search, so it adds one 0.25 MiB pass on the common path and one whole-file read when the session has no generated title. The 003 limitation calls it a "second tail search" [SOURCE: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions/session-turn-boundaries/002-session-relaunch-loop/039-hop-dialog-goal-title/003-generated-title-carry/implementation-summary.md:129]; in `readClaudeSettings` it is the third, the second title search.

**CONFIRMED — the carrier is a new note frontmatter field, and that is D3-neutral.** D3 forbids a new module and a new relaunch record key [SOURCE: specs/hooks-plugins-extensions/session-turn-boundaries/002-session-relaunch-loop/039-hop-dialog-goal-title/goal.md:49]. The outgoing note's frontmatter is written by prepare through `recordGoalPacket` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:941] and read by consume [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/bin/session-relaunch.cjs:796]. A field such as `goal_ended: true` (or `goal_ending: cleared`) rides there. The pending record's key set is fixed by `preparePending` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:990]; adding a key there would violate D3, so the record stays untouched. The wrapper can pass the latch to the receiver through an environment variable beside `SESSION_RELAUNCH_GOAL_PACKET` [SOURCE: .skilled/bin/skilled-loop:1331], and the receiver's `prepare` can suppress the fallback for one hop and rewrite the latch onward. **Cost:** three source files (`bin/session-relaunch.cjs` for write and consume, `lib/relaunch-core.cjs` for the fallback guard and note field, `.skilled/bin/skilled-loop` for the env hand-off), no new module, no record key, plus resolver, CLI and wrapper tests. **Smallest change:** the latch in `claudeGoalPacketResult` when `whole` is true; clear it when the sender's log has an active goal.

**CONFIRMED — the fallback has no proof that the chosen ancestor relates to the session.** The active-goal path requires the packet's goal.md to carry the goal's opening line [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:671] [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:675]. The no-entry fallback passes only `packetGoalIsSettable` [SOURCE: .skilled/hooks/session-relaunch/lib/relaunch-core.cjs:656], which checks budget and an unticked box and nothing about the note's task. A stale parent goal.md with an open criterion is therefore eligible even when the session's own work is elsewhere.
